description: Allows AIFundOS to select a strategy family and plan, fill, manage, close, review, and learn from defined-loss simulated positions without human approval. It never authorizes live brokerage activity.
immutable_guardrails: Paper trading only; no live brokerage connection or live order authority.
Risk Manager veto and hard portfolio risk limits cannot be overridden.
No entry when the data-quality gate is below the policy minimum.
Only defined-loss instruments may be used.
Every autonomous decision, fill, exit, and policy adaptation must be logged.
Risk and daily order capacity may not expand until at least 30 autonomous tactical trades have closed.
The Committee may tune soft experiment parameters only within adaptive_bounds.
